about: The rates of value added tax (goods and services tax in Australia) each country the library writes for has, for the rule that a rate on a document is a rate its country has (skills/_checks/money_check.py). "rates" are the rates in force as read; "other" are rates that were in force until a date or belong to one scheme, each with its note: a document that carries one passes with a question. Zero is always a rate. Special territories and schemes with rates of their own (Corsica, the Canary Islands, Jungholz and Mittelberg, flat-rate farmers, the recargo de equivalencia) are not in the table. Canada and the United States have no national list: their sales taxes are named one by one on the document, and no rate there is checked against a table.
